primary.name: full_808
primary.role: all image-only, image-plus-clinical, phenotype, and current-CNN comparisons

radiomics_complete_case.name: radiomics_complete_case_375
radiomics_complete_case.role: paired FTV/radiomics and beyond-FTV sensitivity only
radiomics_complete_case.missingness_warning: not interchangeable with the full-808 primary population

binary_readout.selection: maximum validation AUROC, then validation AUPRC, then smaller C, then fixed l1-before-l2 order
binary_readout.outer_test: constructed only after validation selection and passed through one guarded predict_proba call

continuous_readout.selection: minimum validation MSE, then smaller alpha

required_probes.HR: T0, full_808, every formal image source/spatial axis
required_probes.HER2: T0, full_808, every formal image source/spatial axis
required_probes.HR_HER2_subtype: T0 four-class multinomial, full_808, every formal image source/spatial axis

paired_comparisons: each foundation LOCAL MRI-only versus LOCAL0 MRI-only at every decision point
each foundation GLOBAL MRI-only versus GAP0 MRI-only at every decision point
each foundation MRI-plus-clinical versus clinical-only at every decision point
each foundation LOCAL versus its own GLOBAL variant at every decision point
each foundation MRI-plus-clinical-plus-FTV versus clinical-plus-FTV on the same 375 patients
current CNN versus foundation for HR/HER2/subtype and FTV decodability

uncertainty.method: paired patient-level nonparametric bootstrap of fixed OOF predictions
uncertainty.inference_scope: descriptive; no test-driven model selection or multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim

reporting_policy.underuse_interpretation: based on all preregistered paired foundation-versus-current-CNN deltas, not a selected best candidate
reporting_policy.beyond_FTV_interpretation: requires paired clinical+FTV versus clinical+FTV+MRI deltas within the same 375 patients
